levels.bonus: Optional 5–10 min full rest or relaxed breathing only. BJJ: Ignition + A×2/B×1/D×1 (19:00), or skip if class/time load is high.

ignition.name: Curved-Treadmill Walking Intervals
ignition.cue: Walking only; short comfortable stride. Stop if thigh or knee pain rises.

deposits.label: A
deposits.title: BODYLINE — PLANCHE WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 5, 5 RIR. Intentional Monday anchor; NONE VERIFIED. No progression; planche gate remains two user-confirmed clean 3×6–8 exposures.

exercises.name: McGill Curl-Up
exercises.cue: Brace; lift only head/shoulders; use a comfortable knee angle and skip if symptoms reproduce

deposits.label: B
deposits.title: THORACIC MOBILITY — UPPER WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:30; RPE 4, 5 RIR. Compound pull/press withheld and not credited; NONE VERIFIED. New mobility substitute; no progression.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Open Book
exercises.home: Mat open book ×4/side with knees comfortably supported
exercises.away: Floor open book ×4/side with knees comfortably supported
exercises.cue: Support the top arm; rotate only through a pain-free upper-back range; never force shoulder or knee position

deposits.label: C
deposits.title: HINGE + ACTIVE ANKLE MOBILITY
deposits.effort: Rest 1:00; RPE 3–4, 5–6 RIR. Very-light hinge baseline; NONE VERIFIED. No load/ROM progression; loaded/deep knee flexion remains withheld.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.cue: Small knee bend; hips back; stop for thigh, knee, shoulder or radiating symptoms

exercises.name: Knee-to-Wall Ankle Mobilization
exercises.cue: Shallow pain-free knee travel only; heel down; do not force the bend

deposits.label: D
deposits.title: BALANCE — POWER WITHHELD
deposits.effort: Rest 1:30; RPE 4, 5 RIR. Supported balance baseline; NONE VERIFIED. Power receives no credit; reduce hand support only after two user-confirmed pain-free exposures.

exercises.name: Supported Single-Leg Balance
exercises.cue: Light fingertip support; tall posture; almost-straight comfortable stance knee

deposits.label: E
deposits.title: BREATHING ARMOR
deposits.effort: 6:20 including setup; RPE 2, 6 RIR. Recovery only; no conditioning benchmark credit.

exercises.name: Seated Diaphragmatic Breathing
exercises.home: Supported standing, seated, or supine—choose the symptom-free position
exercises.cue: Relax shoulders; expand lower ribs; easy longer exhale; change position if the thigh/knee objects

martialSupplement.name: Technical-Stand-Up Visualization
martialSupplement.home: Watch exact demo; mentally rehearse only—no physical drilling
martialSupplement.cue: Separate; no reps while shoulder and thigh/knee symptoms remain unresolved; never auto-log
